title: In Praise of Scribes
review_method: AI-assisted triage of frozen local English and Latin OCR artifacts; no human or scan verification claimed
offset_convention: zero-based Unicode code points in UTF-8 text with LF newlines; end exclusive; lines one-based
scope_note: This pilot compares archival English from each opening title through the final ownership note. Model headers and later digitization metadata are outside scope; page and segment labels are ignored by token alignment. Fifteen selected cases receive provisional semantic triage; three equivalent-wording controls are retained. This is not an exhaustive philological review.

items.title: Did the undertaking exceed his abilities?
items.difference: The earlier text negates exceeding his abilities; T4B affirms it.
items.impact: This reverses the claim about the author's ability and his reliance on divine help.
items.latin_assessment: The earlier OCR preserves excedere nō ignoraui; the T4B OCR also retains a negative form before ignozaui. The negation belongs to knowing/being unaware, which tentatively supports the T4B sense.
items.next_action: Check the printed negation and verb, then adjudicate the full sentence; do not transfer the negation onto excedere.
